assertions.assertion: The patient presents with persistent palpitations and a history of symptomatic bradycardia consistent with sick sinus syndrome.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered for continuous ambulatory electrocardiographic evaluation.
The ordered service corresponds to CPT code 93226.
CPT code 93226 represents a 48-hour Holter monitoring study.
The service is supported by the associated diagnoses I49.5, I49.9, and R00.2.
The denial under reason code CO-22 cites coordination of benefits protocols.
The clinical indication documents the medical necessity of this service for the documented symptoms and arrhythmia characterization.
